name: Taiwan Sanyo Electric Co.,Ltd.
summary: Taiwan Sanyo Electric Co.,Ltd. is a company specializing in the production and distribution of consumer electronics, serving both the Taiwanese domestic market and international customers. Under its distinctive SANLUX brand, the firm offers a broad array of household products. These include major appliances for climate control such as air conditioners, dehumidifiers, fans, and bathroom ventilation heaters, alongside kitchen and food preservation devices like refrigerators, freezers, and various cooking products. Their offerings also extend to entertainment systems, including televisions and audio-visual accessories, as well as general home living items and digital communication gadgets. The company was founded in 1963 and has its main corporate offices situated in Taipei, Taiwan.
